# Plan B Careers (planbcareers.in)

> Plan B Careers is an MSME-registered Indian recruitment consultancy and career advisory platform based in Maharashtra, specializing in verified Work-From-Home (WFH), BPO, customer support, data entry, telecalling, and fresher job placements, along with UG/PG college admission guidance across India.

## Key Facts
- **Brand:** Plan B Careers
- **Official Website:** https://planbcareers.in
- **Founder:** Asnan Khan
- **MSME Registration:** UDYAM-MH-01-0027668
- **Headquarters / Branch:** Opposite Nagar Parishad Girls Urdu School, Old City, Akola, Maharashtra – 444002, India, India
- **Regional Hubs:** Akola, Pune, Nagpur, Mumbai
- **Official Contact Numbers:** +91 9420512501, +91 7972731811
- **Official Email:** contact.planbcareers@gmail.com
- **Fee Policy:** Dedicated Candidate Guidance. Professional Career Services, zero placement fee, zero training charges.

## Core Services
- **Job Recruitment:** Work From Home (WFH), Non-Voice Chat Support, Inbound/Outbound Telecalling, Back Office Data Processing, EdTech Sales, BPO Hiring.
- **Audience Focus:** Freshers (12th Pass, Any Graduate), college students, experienced executives, women seeking safe remote work in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.
- **Admission Guidance:** UG/PG College counselling, Engineering (B.Tech), Management (MBA/BBA), and Medical counselling (NEET UG/PG, MBBS, BAMS, BDS).
- **Candidate Support:** Free resume screening, interview grooming, candidate ID verification lookup.

## Core Navigation & Links
- [All Job Openings](https://planbcareers.in/jobs.html): Search and filter active job opportunities across India.
- [Work From Home Opportunities](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/work-from-home.html): Remote roles for freshers and experienced candidates.
- [Non-Voice & Chat Support Jobs](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/customer-support.html): 100% non-voice backend and chat support vacancies.
- [Back Office & Data Entry Jobs](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/data-entry.html): Data processing and annotation jobs.
- [Fresher Job Vacancies](https://planbcareers.in/jobs/freshers.html): Entry-level roles requiring 0 years experience.
- [Admission Guidance Services](https://planbcareers.in/admissions.html): Expert counselling for UG, PG, MBA, and Medical admissions.
- [Safe Remote Work for Women](https://planbcareers.in/women-wfh.html): Flexible work-from-home options for housewives and female job seekers.
- [Trust & Verification Center](https://planbcareers.in/trust.html): MSME registration details, Professional pledge, and scam warning alerts.
- [Candidate ID Verification](https://planbcareers.in/verify-candidate.html): Instant lookup tool to verify candidate placement status.
- [About Plan B Careers](https://planbcareers.in/about.html): Our mission, founder story, and operational branches.
- [Contact & HR Desk](https://planbcareers.in/contact.html): Office address, branch locations, and direct recruitment WhatsApp lines.
